SEO.title: AI Practicum — AI tools for your job
SEO.description: Online course: in 6 weeks, learn to use AI at work — writing, analytics, presentations and automating routine tasks.

Footer.disclaimer: Portfolio demo project: the school and the course are fictional.

Main.title: AI tools for your job
Main.description: A hands-on online course: in 6 weeks you will set up AI tools for your own tasks and start saving hours every week.

Audience.title: Who the course is for
Audience.description: No coding required: you will learn to solve work tasks in the tools you already use.

office.name: Office professionals
office.description: Emails, reports and meeting notes in minutes instead of hours.

marketing.name: Marketers
marketing.description: Ideas, copy and visuals for campaigns, review and competitor analysis.

analytics.name: Analysts
analytics.description: Making sense of spreadsheets, formulas and insights without manual routine.

business.name: Business owners
business.description: Automated sales and support, quick drafts of documents.

Program.title: Course curriculum
Program.description: Six weeks, each with short lessons and 4 hands-on assignments reviewed by a mentor.

basics.name: How neural networks work
basics.description: What language models can and cannot do, how to pick a tool for the task and keep sensitive data out of the chat.

prompts.name: Prompts for work
prompts.description: Prompt structure, roles and examples, follow-up questions. You build your own library of templates.

texts.name: Texts and documents
texts.description: Emails, reports, meeting notes and editing: from a rough draft to a finished document in your style.

data.name: Spreadsheets and data
data.description: Working with exports, formulas, spotting patterns and clear conclusions for your manager.

visuals.name: Presentations and visuals
visuals.description: Presentation structure, generating images and diagrams, styling slides with your company template.

automation.name: Automation and final project
automation.description: Connect a neural network to your work tools and present a project built on a real task from your job.
